headline: Design systems, UX engineering, and front-end platforms
summary: Team-focused UI/UX engineer with twenty years of design and development work behind an organization’s daily operations. Skilled in design discovery, visual design, prototyping, and front-end development, and at home working with cross-functional leaders to find and resolve issues, set priorities, and deliver a high level of service.

experience.summary: Senior creative design engineer and lead design system manager, bringing a user-centered approach to every product in the organization: the design system, front-end component libraries, and UI and UX design and development across the digital product line.
highlights: Created the Figma design system: brand style guide, UI kit, design tokens, component library, and documentation structure.
Started the Storybook and React component library pipeline with Figma integration.
Established a design tokens workflow that syncs Figma variables to JSON tokens.
Developed responsive prototyping templates and front-end components for company-wide libraries.

experience.summary: Lead design consultant guiding Amazon sellers through onboarding: branded web themes designed in Figma and implemented on the platform, plus the live support, FAQ, article, and video features their knowledge bases grow from.
highlights: Created a CSS framework that automates layout and styling changes across the platform.
Refactored the HTML framework behind support landing pages so content is easier to change.
Converted more than 200 non-responsive sites to mobile-friendly layouts.
Developed a grid system for videos, article lists, and calls to action.

experience.summary: Designed and built web and Unity interface systems for a healthcare simulation training platform: the “Workbench” VR authoring platform, 6 web applications, 10 VR applications, marketing materials, and customer support.
highlights: Established brand design systems and a style guide for the web and VR engineering teams.
Created a web component system with Vue.js and Storybook.
Established a VR design system with Unity UI Toolkit for rapid prototyping.
Built interactive prototypes, mockups, and wireframes in Figma, Sketch, and HTML.
Led design sprints and VR interface training for web, VR, and marketing teams.

experience.summary: Lead designer and developer for a web templating platform: branding, UI/UX prototypes, DevOps, customer experience, and project management.
highlights: Produced 2 front-end design systems for rapid Kentico development.
Established a custom CSS framework for rapid prototyping.
Developed front-end architecture for 3 startups.
Revised 2 non-responsive code bases.

experience.summary: Interface designer and front-end developer for a non-profit ministry network: branding, web design and development, Kentico CMS integration, and platform onboarding.
highlights: Delivered 40+ responsive websites for departments and missions, improving donation rates.
Created a Bootstrap framework and template system that cut Kentico development time.
Established documentation and guidelines for the client discovery team.

experience.summary: Web designer and front-end developer on a Kentico CMS platform, providing visual and interaction design plus client branding and content.
highlights: Delivered 20+ responsive websites for churches large and small.
Designed 30+ sites for ministries and organized sports clubs.

experience.company: Defense Language Institute Foreign Language Center

highlights: Delivered 100+ training videos and graphics for iOS apps that help deployed personnel communicate across cultures.
Introduced the first responsive website template system.
Optimized admin dashboards so staff could update content from their phones.

experience.summary: Web design, front-end development, video editing, and graphic design, in-house and as a freelance contractor.
highlights: Delivered 20+ WordPress designs and templates for a real estate listing search engine.
Developed the visual design process for targeted retention campaigns.
Edited video for live events and cable programming.

experience.summary: Motion graphics, video editing, and DVD authoring for a live event production company, with clients including Pizza Hut, American Airlines, MasterCard, NCR, and Pitney Bowes.
highlights: Designed 20+ live event motion graphics packages.
Produced 50+ DVD interfaces and packaging templates.
